chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who reject the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or calamity, a cry of distress in Hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat (77:24) underscores the inevitable divine retribution for those who persistently deny the prophetic message, linking their denial to the specific torment of Hellfire. It serves as a warning that rejection of truth is not merely an intellectual stance but a spiritual condition leading to eternal suffering, a theme central to the concept of *Barzakh* and final judgment in Shia theology.
